items.source:
Trace messages are written on method entry, and if the method invocation succeeds
on method exit. If an invocation results in an exception, then an exception message
is written. The contents of these trace messages is fully customizable and special
placeholders are available to allow you to include runtime information in your log
messages. The placeholders available are:
items.translation: 跟踪消息在方法入口处写入，并在方法调用成功时在方法出口处写入。如果调用导致异常，则会写入异常消息。这些跟踪消息的内容完全可自定义，并且提供特殊占位符以允许您在日志消息中包含运行时信息。可用的占位符如下：

items.source:
There are restrictions on which placeholders can be used in which messages:
see the individual message properties for details on the valid placeholders.
items.translation: 哪些占位符可用于哪些消息存在限制：有关有效占位符的详细信息，请查看各个消息属性。

items.source:
Set the template used for method exit log messages. This template can contain any of the following placeholders:
  • $[targetClassName]
  • $[targetClassShortName]
  • $[argumentTypes]
  • $[arguments]
  • $[returnValue]
  • $[invocationTime]
items.translation:
设置用于方法退出日志消息的模板。 该模板可以包含以下任意占位符：
  • $[targetClassName]
  • $[targetClassShortName]
  • $[argumentTypes]
  • $[arguments]
  • $[returnValue]
  • $[invocationTime]

items.source:
Set the template used for method exception log messages. This template can contain any of the following placeholders:
  • $[targetClassName]
  • $[targetClassShortName]
  • $[argumentTypes]
  • $[arguments]
  • $[exception]
items.translation:
设置用于方法异常日志消息的模板。 该模板可以包含以下任意占位符：
  • $[targetClassName]
  • $[targetClassShortName]
  • $[argumentTypes]
  • $[arguments]
  • $[exception]

items.source:
Set the template used for method entry log messages. This template can contain any of the following placeholders:
  • $[targetClassName]
  • $[targetClassShortName]
  • $[argumentTypes]
  • $[arguments]
items.translation:
设置用于方法入口日志消息的模板。 该模板可以包含以下任意占位符：
  • $[targetClassName]
  • $[targetClassShortName]
  • $[argumentTypes]
  • $[arguments]

items.source: The $[exception] placeholder. Replaced with the String representation of any Throwable raised during method invocation.
items.translation: `$[exception]` 占位符。 替换为方法调用期间抛出的任何 `Throwable` 的 `String` 表示形式。

items.source: Writes a log message before the invocation based on the value of enterMessage. If the invocation succeeds, then a log message is written on exit based on the value exitMessage. If an exception occurs during invocation, then a message is written based on the value of exceptionMessage.
items.translation: 根据 `<code>enterMessage` 的值，在调用前写入日志消息。如果调用成功，则根据值 `<code>exitMessage`` 在退出时写入日志消息。如果在调用期间发生异常，则根据 `<code>exceptionMessage` 的值写入消息。

items.source: The $[targetClassName] placeholder. Replaced with the fully-qualified name of the Class of the method invocation target.
items.translation: $[targetClassName] 占位符。 替换为方法调用目标的 Class 的完全限定名称。

items.source: The $[targetClassShortName] placeholder. Replaced with the short name of the Class of the method invocation target.
items.translation: $[targetClassShortName] 占位符。替换为方法调用目标的 Class 的短名称。

items.source: The $[returnValue] placeholder. Replaced with the String representation of the value returned by the method invocation.
items.translation: $[returnValue] 占位符。 替换为方法调用返回值的 String 表示形式。

items.source: The $[arguments] placeholder. Replaced with a comma separated list of the argument values for the method invocation. Relies on the toString() method of each argument type.
items.translation: `$[arguments]` 占位符。替换为方法调用中参数值的逗号分隔列表。依赖于每个参数类型的 `toString()` 方法。

items.source: The $[methodName] placeholder. Replaced with the name of the method being invoked.
items.translation: $[methodName] 占位符。 替换为被调用的方法名称。

items.source: The $[argumentTypes] placeholder. Replaced with a comma-separated list of the argument types for the method invocation. Argument types are written as short class names.
items.translation: $[argumentTypes] 占位符。替换为方法调用参数类型的逗号分隔列表。参数类型以短类名书写。

items.source: The $[invocationTime] placeholder. Replaced with the time taken by the invocation (in milliseconds).
items.translation: $[invocationTime] 占位符。替换为调用所花费的时间（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source:
Replace the placeholders in the given message with the supplied values,
or values derived from those supplied.
items.translation: 将给定消息中的占位符替换为提供的值，或从这些提供的值派生的值。

items.source: throwable - any Throwable raised during the invocation. The value of Throwable.toString() is replaced for the $[exception] placeholder. May be null.
items.translation: `throwable` - 在调用期间抛出的任何 `Throwable`。 `Throwable.toString()` 的值将替换 `$[exception]` 占位符。可能为 `null`。

items.source: invokeUnderTrace in class AbstractTraceInterceptor
items.translation: `invokeUnderTrace` 类中的 `AbstractTraceInterceptor`

items.source: methodInvocation - the MethodInvocation being logged. Used to derive values for all placeholders except $[exception] and $[returnValue].
items.translation:
`methodInvocation` - 正在记录的 `MethodInvocation`。
用于推导除 `$[exception]` 和 `$[returnValue]` 之外的所有占位符的值。

items.source: $[exception] - replaced with the String representation of any Throwable raised during the invocation
items.translation: $[exception] - 替换为调用期间抛出的任何 Throwable 的 String 表示形式

items.source: returnValue - any value returned by the invocation. Used to replace the $[returnValue] placeholder. May be null.
items.translation: returnValue - 调用返回的任何值。用于替换 $[returnValue] 占位符。可能为 null。

items.source: $[arguments] - replaced with a comma-separated list of the String representation of the method arguments
items.translation: `$[arguments]` - 替换为方法参数的 `String` 表示形式的逗号分隔列表

items.source: invocationTime - the value to write in place of the $[invocationTime] placeholder
items.translation: invocationTime - 用于替换 $[invocationTime] 占位符的值

items.source: $[methodName] - replaced with the name of the method being invoked
items.translation: `$[methodName]` - 替换为被调用的方法名

items.source: $[targetClassName] - replaced with the name of the class that is the target of the invocation
items.translation: `$[targetClassName]` - 替换为被调用目标的类名

items.source: $[targetClassShortName] - replaced with the short name of the class that is the target of the invocation
items.translation: `$[targetClassShortName]` - 替换为被调用目标的类的短名称

items.source: $[returnValue] - replaced with the value returned by the invocation
items.translation: `$[returnValue]` - 替换为调用返回的值

items.source: $[argumentTypes] - replaced with a comma-separated list of the short class names of the method arguments
items.translation: `$[argumentTypes]` - 替换为方法参数的短类名的逗号分隔列表

items.source: $[invocationTime] - replaced with the time, in milliseconds, taken by the method invocation
items.translation: `$[invocationTime]` - 替换为方法调用所花费的时间（以毫秒为单位）

items.source: message - the message template containing the placeholders to be replaced
items.translation: message - 包含待替换占位符的消息模板

items.source: the formatted output to write to the log
items.translation: 要写入日志的格式化输出

items.source: Writes a log message before the invocation based on the value of enterMessage.
items.translation: 根据enterMessage的值，在调用之前写入日志消息。

items.source: Set the template used for method entry log messages.
items.translation: 设置用于方法入口日志消息的模板。

items.source: Set the template used for method exception log messages.
items.translation: 设置用于方法异常日志消息的模板。

items.source: Set the template used for method exit log messages.
items.translation: 设置用于方法退出日志消息的模板。

items.source: Throwable - if the call to MethodInvocation.proceed() encountered any errors
items.translation: Throwable - 如果调用 MethodInvocation.proceed() 遇到任何错误

items.source: logger - the Log to write trace messages to
items.translation: logger - 用于写入跟踪消息的 Log

items.source: the result of the call to MethodInvocation.proceed()
items.translation: 对 `MethodInvocation.proceed()` 调用的结果

items.translation: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
